name: world-map
title: World Map
blurb: Animated world map with curved connection lines between locations.
description: Renders a dotted world map with theme-aware coloring via next-themes (dark/light backgrounds). Displays animated curved SVG paths connecting geographic coordinates with customizable line color.
use_when: Team pages, dashboards, or landing pages showcasing global reach or distributed operations.
avoid_when: When real geographic precision is needed; uses simplified Mercator projection for visual appeal.
a11y: SVG-based map with alt text on background image; path animations are decorative.

props.name: dots
props.type: Array<{start: {lat: number; lng: number; label?: string}; end: {lat: number; lng: number; label?: string}}>
